MYSTS2MOD-SPARK.title: Spark
MYSTS2MOD-HAO_STRIKE.title: Hao Strike
MYSTS2MOD-HAO_STRIKE.description:
Deal {CalculationBase:diff()} damage. Deals 1 additional damage per Hao.{InCombat:
(Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
MYSTS2MOD-HAO_DEFEND.title: Hao Defend
MYSTS2MOD-HAO_DEFEND.description:
Gain Block equal to triple your Hao, up to {BlockCap:diff()}.{InCombat:
(Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} Block)|}
MYSTS2MOD-NARCISSISM.title: Narcissism
MYSTS2MOD-FIGURE_SHADOW.title: Figure Shadow
MYSTS2MOD-DEBUGGING.title: Debugging
MYSTS2MOD-DEBUGGING.description:
If you have more than 10 Hao, reduce it to 10 and gain Block equal to twice the amount removed.{InCombat:
(Gain {HasHaoToLose:{CalculatedBlock:diff()}|0} Block)|}
MYSTS2MOD-CODE_OFFENSE.title: Code Offense
MYSTS2MOD-CODE_OFFENSE.description:
Deal 2 damage per Hao. If you have at least 6 Hao, double this card's damage.{InCombat:
(Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
MYSTS2MOD-KICK_UP.title: Kick Up
MYSTS2MOD-KICK_UP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Gain 3 Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-EXAM.title: Exam
MYSTS2MOD-EXAM.description: Double your Hao. If you had at least 10 Hao before doubling it, heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
MYSTS2MOD-CALM.title: Calm
MYSTS2MOD-CALM.description:
Lose all Hao. Deal damage equal to 4 times the amount lost and gain that much Block.{InCombat:
(Deal {HasHaoToLose:{CalculatedDamage:diff()}|0} damage, gain {HasHaoToLose:{CalculatedBlock:diff()}|0} Block)|}
MYSTS2MOD-CONFLICT.title: Conflict
MYSTS2MOD-CONFLICT.description: Apply {Vulnerable:diff()} Vulnerable. If you have at least 10 Hao, additionally deal {Damage:diff()} damage and lose 5 Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-FIRE_IN_SOUL.title: Fire in Soul
MYSTS2MOD-FIRE_IN_SOUL.description: Apply {Frail} Frail to yourself. Draw {Cards:diff()} card(s) and gain {Energy} energy.
MYSTS2MOD-SURFING.title: Surfing
MYSTS2MOD-SURFING.description: Choose a card from your discard pile and put it on top of your draw pile. Lose {HaoCost} Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-SURFING.selectPrompt: Choose a card to put on top of your draw pile.
MYSTS2MOD-STUDENT_LEADER.title: Student Leader
MYSTS2MOD-STUDENT_LEADER.description: Lose all Hao. Gain 1 Dexterity for every 4 Hao lost.
MYSTS2MOD-SHANG_HAI_STUDENT.title: Shanghai Student
MYSTS2MOD-SHANG_HAI_STUDENT.description: This turn, every card you play grants 1 Hao and {BlockEach:diff()} Block.
MYSTS2MOD-SNEER.title: Sneer
MYSTS2MOD-SNEER.description: Apply {Vulnerable} Vulnerable to yourself. This turn, when you block damage from an enemy, deal damage equal to the amount blocked back to that enemy.
MYSTS2MOD-EQUAL680.title: Equal 680
MYSTS2MOD-EQUAL680.description: While your Max HP is lower than the target enemy's, you deal 3 additional damage.
MYSTS2MOD-GROUP_DISCUSS.title: Group Discussion
MYSTS2MOD-GROUP_DISCUSS.description: If the target intends to Attack, gain 1 Intangible. Otherwise, deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT.title: Unrepentant
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT.description: Until the start of your next turn, damage consumes Block normally, but the remaining damage is converted into equal Hao instead of HP loss. Next turn, whenever you play a card, take 2 blockable damage.
MYSTS2MOD-GENIUS.title: Genius
MYSTS2MOD-GENIUS.description: At the start of your turn, gain 1 energy and draw {Draw:diff()} card(s). After you lose Hao, the next damage you take from an enemy is doubled; fully blocking it still consumes the effect.
MYSTS2MOD-GRAMMAR.title: Grammar
MYSTS2MOD-GRAMMAR.description: Add a random upgraded Skill card to your hand; it costs 0 this turn. If you have at least 10 Hao, it costs 0 for the rest of this combat instead.
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_HAO.title: Magnificent Hao
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_HAO.description: This turn, the first card you draw and every 2 cards drawn after it grant 1 Hao. From the end of this turn until the end of your next turn, draw 1 card the first time you gain Hao and every 2 times after that.
MYSTS2MOD-MATH_PRINCE.title: Math Prince
MYSTS2MOD-MATH_PRINCE.description: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Strength for every 4 Hao you have. Lose that Strength at the end of your turn.
MYSTS2MOD-CODE_CODE_CODE.title: Code Code Code
MYSTS2MOD-CODE_CODE_CODE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Whenever you lose Hao, return this card from your discard pile to your hand.
MYSTS2MOD-SUPER_HAO_FIELD.title: Super Hao Field
MYSTS2MOD-SUPER_HAO_FIELD.description: At the end of your turn, gain Block equal to half your Hao (rounded down) and deal that much damage to ALL enemies.
MYSTS2MOD-TSINGHUA_FORM.title: Tsinghua Form
MYSTS2MOD-TSINGHUA_FORM.description: Whenever you lose Hao, regain half the amount lost (rounded down) and gain that much Block.
MYSTS2MOD-INFINITE_HAO.title: Infinite Hao
MYSTS2MOD-INFINITE_HAO.description: While you have at least 3 Hao, snapshot your Hao, lose 3 Hao, then deal damage equal to the snapshot X times. Stop if Hao does not decrease.{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]X is increased by 1[/gold].|}
MYSTS2MOD-BETTER_THAN_WALKER.title: Better Than Walker
MYSTS2MOD-BETTER_THAN_WALKER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Then kill enemies whose HP is not higher than your Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-FINAL_COMMIT.title: Final Commit
MYSTS2MOD-FINAL_COMMIT.description: You cannot gain Block this turn. At the end of your turn, double your Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-HINDSIGHT.title: Hindsight
MYSTS2MOD-HINDSIGHT.description: Lose {HaoCost} Hao. Gain {Block:diff()} Block next turn.
MYSTS2MOD-NEW_GROUP_CHAT.title: New Group Chat
MYSTS2MOD-XIAO.title: Xiao
MYSTS2MOD-XIAO.description: Gain {Hao:diff()} Hao and {Block:diff()} Block. Next turn, add a {IfUpgraded:show:Chuan+|Chuan} to your hand.
MYSTS2MOD-CHUAN.title: Chuan
MYSTS2MOD-CHUAN.description: Lose {HaoCost} Hao. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Lose {HpLoss} HP. Next turn, add a {IfUpgraded:show:Xiao+|Xiao} to your hand.
MYSTS2MOD-UNSPOKEN_FURY.title: Unspoken Fury
MYSTS2MOD-UNSPOKEN_FURY.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. If you take unblocked damage between the start of this turn and the start of your next turn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies again at the start of your next turn.
MYSTS2MOD-GOD_LIST.title: The “God” List
MYSTS2MOD-GOD_LIST.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Then enter the Hidden State.
MYSTS2MOD-APPEAR.title: Appear
MYSTS2MOD-APPEAR.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Then enter Hao Mode.
MYSTS2MOD-QUANTUM_MECHANICS.title: Quantum Mechanics
MYSTS2MOD-QUANTUM_MECHANICS.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you are in the Hidden State, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
MYSTS2MOD-SHI_NONG.title: Shi Nong
MYSTS2MOD-SHI_NONG.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you are in Hao Mode, apply {WeakPower:diff()} Weak.
MYSTS2MOD-DERIVATION.title: Derivation?
MYSTS2MOD-DERIVATION.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If you are in the Hidden State, draw {Cards:diff()} card. Choose a card in your Hand to Retain this turn.
MYSTS2MOD-FENCE_SITTER.title: Fence Sitter
MYSTS2MOD-FENCE_SITTER.description: Switch to the other state (enter Hidden State if you have none). Draw {Cards:diff()} card.
MYSTS2MOD-PLANNING.title: Planning
MYSTS2MOD-PLANNING.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Put a card from your Hand on top of your Draw Pile. If you are in the Hidden State, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
MYSTS2MOD-FOOLED_YOU.title: Fooled You
MYSTS2MOD-FOOLED_YOU.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Repeat:diff()} times. Then enter Hao Mode.
MYSTS2MOD-DEPRESSION.title: Depression
MYSTS2MOD-DEPRESSION.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Then enter the Hidden State.
MYSTS2MOD-DUAL_LIFE.title: Double Life
MYSTS2MOD-DUAL_LIFE.description: The first time each turn you switch between Hidden State and Hao Mode, draw {DualLifePower:diff()} card.
MYSTS2MOD-PLAYING_MYSELF.title: Playing Myself
MYSTS2MOD-PLAYING_MYSELF.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Hidden State: gain {Block:diff()} Block. Hao Mode: deal the damage twice instead.
MYSTS2MOD-UNCERTAINTY_PRINCIPLE.title: Uncertainty Principle
MYSTS2MOD-UNCERTAINTY_PRINCIPLE.descript: Exhaust a card from your Hand. If you do, gain {Energy:diff()} Energy and draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Then switch to the other state (enter Hidden State if you have none).
MYSTS2MOD-PRESS_FORWARD.title: Press Forward
MYSTS2MOD-PRESS_FORWARD.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. If your previous card this turn was a Skill, this value includes {ExtraDamage:diff()} bonus damage.
MYSTS2MOD-RHYTHM.title: Rhythm
MYSTS2MOD-RHYTHM.description: During your turn, whenever you gain or lose Hao, gain {RhythmPower:diff()} Block.
MYSTS2MOD-COMPILER_WARNING.title: Compiler Warning
MYSTS2MOD-DEADLINE_SPRINT.title: Deadline Sprint
MYSTS2MOD-DEADLINE_SPRINT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply {WeakPower:diff()} Weak to yourself.
MYSTS2MOD-KEYBOARD_WARRIOR.title: Keyboard Warrior
MYSTS2MOD-CHAT_HISTORY.title: Chat History
MYSTS2MOD-CHAT_HISTORY.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Add 1 Chuan to your hand.
MYSTS2MOD-DERIVATION.selectionScreenProm: Choose {Amount} card in your Hand to Retain this turn.
MYSTS2MOD-PLANNING.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose {Amount} card in your Hand to put on top of your Draw Pile.
MYSTS2MOD-STRIKE.title: Strike
MYSTS2MOD-DEFEND.title: Defend
MYSTS2MOD-SUDDEN_REPENTANCE.title: Sudden Repentance
MYSTS2MOD-COMEBACK.title: Comeback
MYSTS2MOD-COMEBACK.description: At the end of this turn, if you are in Hidden State, Retain all Attack cards and enter Hao Mode at the start of your next turn.
MYSTS2MOD-TIME_WAITS_FOR_NO_ONE.title: Time Waits for No One
MYSTS2MOD-TIME_WAITS_FOR_NO_ONE.descript: While in Hidden State, Attack cards in your Hand Retain. While in Hao Mode, Skill cards in your Hand Retain.
MYSTS2MOD-TIT_FOR_TAT.title: Tit for Tat
MYSTS2MOD-TIT_FOR_TAT.description: Remove all Block from the target and deal that much damage. If the target has no Block, apply {Vulnerable} Vulnerable instead.
